verdict.rationale: Lium is a GPU rental marketplace with an agent-facing API, so a sandbox or test mode is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents no sandbox, test-mode API keys or staging environment where agents can try actions without real rentals or spend. Ephemeral auto-removing pods, scoped keys with budgets, and public no-key price and availability feeds are adjacent controls, not a sandbox environment isolated from production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
